title: Generate the getters
hints: Mapped types can rename keys: `{ [K in keyof T as NewName]: ... }`. Template literal types build the new name, and the built-in `Capitalize<S>` upper-cases the first letter.

`Capitalize` only accepts strings, but `keyof T` may include numbers and symbols. Intersecting with `string` (`K & string`) turns non-string keys into `never` — and remapping a key to `never` drops it.
type Getters<T> = { [K in keyof T as `get${Capitalize<K & string>}`]: () => T[K] };
